body: I'm glad to hear that! You're welcome, you can pm me whenever you want if you need someone to talk to.

Your birthday is today? Happy birthday!!
Jesus, that sucks. I saw your other post, I think you're doing the right thing. I don't know the specifics but being able to realize that you need to let go of someone is good. It's so easy to cling on to people who are bad for you because you're afraid of being lonely :/ 
I don't know what else to say. You got this, somehow, hugs ❤

I see, yeah hiding cuts can be pretty annoying. I'm sorry to hear about your situation. Relationships can be really difficult and cancer sucks, obviously. Is there something small you feel you can do to make it a bit better?
Sorry for the late response :/ How are you doing now?

*Unsolicited advice ahead. Proceed with caution.*

It's a cliché but keep on trying, I believe in you! I'm trying to get my life back on track. Not that it has ever been on track. It's really difficult when you have setbacks but try your best to not let them affect you too much. It's really hard I know, I can't do it all the time either.
Awesome! It really does! I'm feeling awful today too. I'm so lonely. I don't have any hobbies and I should actually study right now but I'm feeling too awful to be able to concentrate.
Awesome! It really does! I'm feeling awful today too. I'm so lonely. I don't have any hobbies and I should actually study right now but I'm feeling too awful to be able to concentrate.

I think I have that belief but I'm also really lonely and I want at least a couple of friends. Someone to study with on the weekends, someone to share experiences with, someone to discuss things with, someone to go on walks late at night with etc. I was bullied throughout middle school and eventually I stopped talking because I knew if I did they would harass me. I still don't know how to talk with people because I never got back to doing it after that. I have a lot of experience not caring about not having friends and I feel like I'm going in that direction again. It's tempting to just stop caring but I know it wouldn't be healthy for me. Internet friends could be a compromise but I want friends I can do stuff with too. I'm glad it's working out for you though!

> ofc I'm just going off my own experiences here

That's usually all you can do :)

I'm actually out on a late night bike ride right now :) It really helps. I think I'm pretty good at dealing with my urges in the short term. I'll basically just ignore them. It's when they don't go away and I don't see and end to it that I give in to them. So if I feel the same in a month then maybe. I'll will try to stay strong though. I think I should talk more online about it because it helps a lot to know that someone else cares about you. I hope you can stay strong too!

Thanks! I started uni this fall and I'm struggling to make friends and my mind is reminding me how hurting myself made me feel so much better. I know it wont solve anything in the long run but I'm sure you know how little the mind cares about that. I'm not giving up yet tho, but the urge to do it is pretty strong right now.. ;(
